text: The Toronto Urban Health Fund Review Panel to consider appeals to the allocation of 2019 grants.

The Toronto Urban Health Fund Review Panel recommends to the Board of Health that: 1. The Board of Health approve additional funding in the amount of $4,658.00 for the Street Health Community Nursing Foundation for the Evening Harm Reduction Group Project. 2. T he Board of Health approve additional funding in the amount of $325.00 for the For Youth Initiative in Toronto for the Studio Project at For Youth Initiative. 3. The Board of Health approve the following additional projects for the funding indicated: Organization, Project Name Year - Funding Recommendation Scadding Court Community Centre HeARTwork 2019 - $48,547.00 2-Spirited People of the First Nation Inawendiwag (they are related); Restoring kinship is harm reduction and HIV prevention 2019 - $21,700.00 Flemingdon Health Centre Community Consultation – Roma Youth Residents of Flemingdon and Thorncliffe Park 2019 - $55,305.00
